title: Grab Bar 60-Inch Extended 3-Post ADA Compliant | Mediterranean Blue | Pipeline Grab Bars | Allied Brass
short_title: Pipeline Extended 3 Post Grab Bar - 60 Inch, Mediterranean Blue
description:
Create a safer, more accessible bathroom with an extended-length grab bar that provides steady support where you need it most in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate your space easily with the Pipeline look, designed to complement transitional bathroom hardware
- Choose a finish that suits your bathroom décor with multiple designer finish options available
- Ideal for everyday support in the shower, tub area, or along the bathroom wall for caregivers, seniors, and accessible design

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Extended 3-post bathroom grab bar
- Collection: Pipeline / grab bars collection
- Length: 60-Inch (overall product dimensions: 63 in. L x 3 in. H x 3.58 in. W)
- Compliance: ADA Compliant
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
